spirit: Breath of Darkness Down Your Spine

rules.name: TERROR STALKS THE LAND
rules.text:
You have an Incarna ( [Breath of Darkness Down Your Spine] ). Empower [Breath of Darkness Down Your Spine] after uncovering [Empowered] . You may Abduct 1 [Explorer] / [Town] at empowered [Breath of Darkness Down Your Spine] each [Fasticon] phase.
 To Abduct a piece, Move it to The Endless Dark ( [Endless Dark] ). When pieces Escape, Move them to non-Ocean lands with your [Presence] / [Breath of Darkness Down Your Spine] ; if they have no legal land to move to, you lose.
 When your Powers would directly damage or directly destroy the only Invader in a land, instead Abduct it. (Check if it is alone at the start of the damage/destroy instruction. [Endless Dark] is not a land.)
rules.turn:
-- "To Abduct a piece, Move it to The Endless Dark."
abduct X, ~move X endless-dark
-- "Empower [Incarna] after uncovering [Empowered]."
uncover S empowered-space, spirit:special S terror, incarna-of S I, +empowered I
-- "You may Abduct 1 Explorer/Town at empowered [Incarna] each Fast phase."
fast-phase, spirit:special S terror, incarna-of S I, empowered I, at I L, land L
  ~abduct-offer S L
#acc abduct-option : land e
abduct-offer S L / abduct-option L decline
abduct-offer S L, at X L, piece:kind X explorer / abduct-option L X
abduct-offer S L, at X L, piece:kind X town / abduct-option L X
abduct-offer S L
  ?[rng] A
  !(abduct-option L A)
  ~abduct-choice A
abduct-choice C, is C X, neq X decline, ~abduct X

-- "When pieces Escape, Move them to non-Ocean lands with your Presence /
--  Incarna; if they have no legal land to move to, you lose."
#acc escape-dest : e land
escape X, spirit:special S terror, presence-of S P, at P L, land L
  / escape-dest X L
#acc escape-dest-count : e @sum
escape X / escape-dest-count X 0
escape-dest X L / escape-dest-count X 1
escape X, escape-dest-count X 0, +defeat (escape X)
escape X
  ?[rng] L
  !(escape-dest X L)
  ~escape-to X L
escape-to X C, is C L, ~move X L

-- "When your Powers would directly damage or directly destroy the only
--  Invader in a land, instead Abduct it."  Approximation: "alone" is
--  checked at the start of the Power, not of the destroy instruction.
--  `land L` matters: land:invader-count also has rows for endless-dark
--  ("Endless Dark is not a land").
use-power S P, spirit:special S terror, land:invader-count L 1, land L,
  at X L, piece:kind X K, invader K,
  { destroy X => ~abduct X }
rules.evidence: empowered bod after uncover; fast-phase abduct of l1 Explorer/Town (move *122 endless-dark); Power aimed at l3's lone Explorer: abduct *177 instead of destroy; escape moves pieces to a land with Presence, and with no Presence left: defeat (escape X).
rules.notes: Presence tracks are not modeled: 'uncovering' is an `uncover S empowered-space` episode. 'Alone' is checked at the start of the Power, not of the destroy instruction. Damage is not modeled (destroy only). The 'you lose' clause needs a count of destinations (@sum with a 0 row) because an empty choice silently resolves to nothing. First version wrongly applied 'instead Abduct' inside the Endless Dark: the invader count had rows for it; guarding with `land L` fixed it.

rules.name: SHADOW-TOUCHED REALM
rules.text: Your land-targeting Powers can target [Endless Dark] as if it were a land, ignoring Range. ( [Endless Dark] is Inland and has no terrain.)
rules.turn:
targeting S P, spirit:special S shadow-realm, power:targets P land
  / power-target S P endless-dark
-- "(Endless Dark is Inland and has no terrain.)" -- nothing to add: it has no
-- land:terrain row and is not adjacent to an ocean.
rules.evidence: targeted breath dread endless-dark in several seeds; an Explorer there is destroyed normally by the Power.
rules.notes: One added row to the target domain. 'Inland, no terrain' holds automatically: no land:terrain row and no ocean adjacency.

rules.name: A SPACE OF STRANGE AND INFINITE DARKNESS / TRAPPED IN THE ENDLESS DARK
rules.text: The Endless Dark ( [Endless Dark] ) is on the island, but isn't a land and isn't on any board. This can't be a [Sacred Site] . Spirits can't target this even if they have [Presence] here. Adding [Blight] here doesn't destroy [Presence] . Special rules that affect lands do nothing here. Invaders can't take Actions here. Pieces here are on the island when checking for Victory/Defeat. / Fear Cards and Token Events affect pieces here as if this were an Inland land, but can't remove Invaders here - when t[truncated]
rules.turn:
#acc on-island : e
at X L, land L / on-island X
at X endless-dark / on-island X
-- "Fear Cards and Token Events affect pieces here as if this were an Inland
--  land" (no Fear Cards in core; the view is ready for them)
spirit:special S terror / land-for fear endless-dark
rules.evidence: invader-on-island rows include pieces in endless-dark; no Ravage/Build/Explore there; untested for Fear Cards (none in core).
rules.notes: Most clauses hold for free because endless-dark has no `land` row and every base rule quantifies over land (closed-world default). Only the positive 'counts as' clauses need rows (on-island, land-for fear). The truncated remainder of Trapped (removal -> escape?) is not formalized.

base_ext: Range/land targeting (as in spirit-roots.t), land:invader-count, test-only target narrowing, Incarna as a presence-of row.
language_issues: A choice with no options resolves to nothing silently, so 'if there is no legal destination, you lose' needs a separate @sum count of options with a 0 row.

Helper views that range over all locations (land:invader-count via `at X L`) leak into non-lands; every rule about lands needs an explicit `land L` guard. Closed-world 'not a land' is otherwise a strength: most Endless Dark restrictions needed no rules.

A test can narrow a rng choice with an extra `!` constraint read through the named choice tuple (`targeting S dread, (target-chosen S dread T), !(test-target T)`), which is a handy way to force scenarios.
